jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description: Miraista is looking for a passionate and creative Marketing Intern to join our growing team. You'll assist in executing digital marketing campaigns and enhancing our brand visibility across various platforms.
responsibilities: Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns
Create engaging content for social media and other digital platforms
Analyze marketing data and campaign performance
Coordinate with design and content teams to ensure brand consistency
requirements: Pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
Familiarity with social media platforms and marketing tools
Basic knowledge of SEO, content marketing, and analytics
Creative mindset and eagerness to learn
perks: Letter of recommendation upon successful completion
Hands-on experience with live marketing campaigns
Opportunity to contribute to real-world brand growth

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern (Full Stack)
jobs.description: We’re seeking a Software Developer Intern with a passion for full-stack development. You'll work closely with our engineering team to build and improve scalable web applications.
responsibilities: Develop frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React
Work on backend services using Node.js, Express, or Java
Assist in database design and API integration
Collaborate with designers and developers to build new features
Write clean, efficient, and testable code
requirements: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Basic understanding of frontend and backend technologies
Willingness to learn and take on new challenges
Good problem-solving skills and team collaboration
perks: Certificate and recommendation letter upon completion
Potential for full-time opportunity based on performance
